verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents a customizable hosted UI for authentication, and its AuthKit React SDK handles sign-in and sign-up through a hosted flow, with the Astro SDK listing auth components. Profile management through prebuilt UI or hosted pages is not evidenced, and customization depth is only asserted in a single line. Missing for 10: documented profile-management UI or hosted pages, details on how far the hosted UI can be customized, independent or hands-on corroboration of production use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship production sign-in, sign-up, and profile management with prebuilt, customizable UI components or hosted pages

citations.quote: Customizable hosted UI for authentication at any size.
Handles sign-in, sign-up, token refresh, and session management via a hosted OAuth flow.
Session validation, automatic token refresh, PKCE sign-in, route protection, auth components, and a client-island auth store
